[Start Free Trial][59]
[Screenshot of the Bushel Farm dashboard]

## Spend less time at the computer, and more time running your farm

Designed to save time and reduce effort, Bushel's farm management software (formerly FarmLogs,
Bushel Farm) enables farmers to make informed, confident marketing decisions and manage their
resources more efficiently.

[Bushel Farm mobile app screenshot]

It's time to say goodbye to paper checks, fraud risks, and mail delays. Bushel offers a fast,
secure, and simple way to move money including direct deposit. Enrolling in direct deposit with
Bushel is a simple one time setup process. This involves opening a Bushel business account, an
interest bearing bank account provided by the Bancorp bank and a member FDIC. With this account you
can earn competitive interest on your balance, Funds are FDIC insured up to five million dollars
through suite program banks. Receive, send, and request payments from others in the Bushel Network
or invite a business to join. Link existing bank accounts to manage cash flow. Spend your balance
anywhere Visa is accepted with the Bushel Gold Visa debit card and access Bushel Farm for free by
connecting your Bushel business account. Open a Bushel Business account today.

Bushel Business Account

## Banking Built for Agriculture

Open a Bushel Business Account, provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. Member FDIC. Earn competitive
interest,¹ and funds are FDIC insured up to $5 million through sweep program banks.²

[Learn More][60]

# Generate insights for Better decision-making

[Bushel Farm field activity screen showing a fertilizing record]

### Reduce Manual Entry

A faster, easier way to keep farm records and surface decision-making insights.

[Bushel Farm screenshot showing a corn contract with price and quantity]

### Boost Marketing Confidence

Track unsold bushels as prices change, and automatically manage your position with acre profit in
mind.

[Bushel Farm expense summary breaking down per-acre field costs]

### Understand Field-Level Profitability

No spreadsheets needed to easily calculate incomes and expenses to help get you profitability and
position.

[Bushel Farm contract detail screen for a yellow corn contract]

### Track your grain contracts in one place

Import directly from over 3,500 grain and ag retail facilities across the Bushel Network.

[Bushel Farm weather and 24-hour rainfall forecast screen]

### Stop Checking Your Rain Gauges

Easily plan your day with rainfall notifications for each field. Compare current data with past
seasons to make better decisions and keep your operation running smoothly.

[Bushel Farm alerts screen showing market and weather notifications]

### Alerts that Matter

With real-time updates on price changes, you’ll know when it's time to act, helping you make
decisions that can positively impact your bottom line without missing a beat.

[Bushel Farm app preview]

## Reduce the pain of manual entry with automation

Bushel makes managing your farm’s finances easier by integrating with top platforms like John Deere
Operations Center, Climate FieldView, and the Bushel Network.

With access to over 3,500 grain and ag retail facilities, Bushel’s network automatically syncs your
grain contracts directly into Bushel's farm management software.

This automation combines your machine data with grain contracts and input costs, allowing you to
instantly calculate your cost of production, track revenues, and easily see your profit and loss. No
more manual data entry or messy spreadsheets—just real-time insights that help you make smarter
decisions and run a more efficient operation.

## Start Your Free Trial Today!

Get 30 days free to test out all of Bushel's features

# Manage Your Farm. Manage Your Finances.

Bushel's farm management software gives you a ground-level and big-picture view of your farm’s
operational and financial performance.

[Start Free Trial][59]
[Screenshot of the Bushel Farm dashboard]

## Spend less time at the computer, and more time running your farm

Designed to save time and reduce effort, Bushel's farm management software (formerly FarmLogs,
Bushel Farm) enables farmers to make informed, confident marketing decisions and manage their
resources more efficiently.

[Bushel Farm mobile app screenshot]

It's time to say goodbye to paper checks, fraud risks, and mail delays. Bushel offers a fast,
secure, and simple way to move money including direct deposit. Enrolling in direct deposit with
Bushel is a simple one time setup process. This involves opening a Bushel business account, an
interest bearing bank account provided by the Bancorp bank and a member FDIC. With this account you
can earn competitive interest on your balance, Funds are FDIC insured up to five million dollars
through suite program banks. Receive, send, and request payments from others in the Bushel Network
or invite a business to join. Link existing bank accounts to manage cash flow. Spend your balance
anywhere Visa is accepted with the Bushel Gold Visa debit card and access Bushel Farm for free by
connecting your Bushel business account. Open a Bushel Business account today.

Bushel Business Account

## Banking Built for Agriculture

Open a Bushel Business Account, provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. Member FDIC. Earn competitive
interest,¹ and funds are FDIC insured up to $5 million through sweep program banks.²

[Learn More][60]

# Generate insights for Better decision-making

[Bushel Farm field activity screen showing a fertilizing record]

### Reduce Manual Entry

A faster, easier way to keep farm records and surface decision-making insights.

[Bushel Farm screenshot showing a corn contract with price and quantity]

### Boost Marketing Confidence

Track unsold bushels as prices change, and automatically manage your position with acre profit in
mind.

[Bushel Farm expense summary breaking down per-acre field costs]

### Understand Field-Level Profitability

No spreadsheets needed to easily calculate incomes and expenses to help get you profitability and
position.

[Bushel Farm contract detail screen for a yellow corn contract]

### Track your grain contracts in one place

Import directly from over 3,500 grain and ag retail facilities across the Bushel Network.

[Bushel Farm weather and 24-hour rainfall forecast screen]

### Stop Checking Your Rain Gauges

Easily plan your day with rainfall notifications for each field. Compare current data with past
seasons to make better decisions and keep your operation running smoothly.

[Bushel Farm alerts screen showing market and weather notifications]

### Alerts that Matter

With real-time updates on price changes, you’ll know when it's time to act, helping you make
decisions that can positively impact your bottom line without missing a beat.

[Bushel Farm app preview]

## Reduce the pain of manual entry with automation

Bushel makes managing your farm’s finances easier by integrating with top platforms like John Deere
Operations Center, Climate FieldView, and the Bushel Network.

With access to over 3,500 grain and ag retail facilities, Bushel’s network automatically syncs your
grain contracts directly into Bushel's farm management software.

This automation combines your machine data with grain contracts and input costs, allowing you to
instantly calculate your cost of production, track revenues, and easily see your profit and loss. No
more manual data entry or messy spreadsheets—just real-time insights that help you make smarter
decisions and run a more efficient operation.

## Start Your Free Trial Today!

Get 30 days free to test out all of Bushel's features

[Start Free Trial][61][Explore All Plans][62]

## The VIRESTINA™ breakthrough

Cutting-edge science to tackle herbicide resistance

[Read the story][70]

About

Syngenta

**We are a leading, science-based agriculture company, empowering farmers to meet the demands of
modern agriculture. Using cutting-edge innovation, we help farmers to grow resilient, healthy crops
that can feed a growing global population, while promoting sustainable farming practices that
protect and enhance our planet. Headquartered in Switzerland, we are a global agritech leader with
more than 30,000 employees across over 90 countries.**

[Learn more about Syngenta][71]

# Introducing Taranis Yield Impact™

Turning Leaf-Level Insights into Bushels
[ LEARN MORE ][40]

# Loyal to the Leaf

Ask how we're celebrating growers and advisors who trust leaf-level insights to make every acre
count.

# Maximize Your Net Profit

Don’t miss your opportunity for conservation funding in 2026. Get started now to secure your
application.
[ LEARN MORE ][41]

# Experience Leaf-Level Crop Intelligence

See how AI-powered insights drive efficiency and results across every acre
[ EXPERIENCE IT NOW ][42]

# Try Ag Assistant™

The agriculture industry’s first generative AI-powered agronomy engine transforms crop input and
farm management decision making.
[ LEARN MORE ][43]

# Syngenta Crop Protection and Taranis Partner to Drive Solutions for Retailers

Collaboration brings advanced AI-powered recommendations and conservation-focused services to boost
farm productivity and profitability
[ SEE THE NEWS ][44]

## WHAT WE DO

### Crop intelligence at scale


We’re 100% focused on helping advisors demonstrate value for growers and build better relationships
through full-service, leaf-level insights.

[TARANIS FOR ADVISORS][45]

#### Cover more
#### acres

Scout from anywhere and prioritize the farms that require the most attention.

#### Act decisively with
#### more speed

Get timely insights to accelerate decision-making and validate recommendations.

#### Unlock more
#### opportunities

Show growers how to maximize yield to improve planning and boost their bottom line.

## Experience the Future of Agriculture

## WHY PARTNER WITH TARANIS

### See the big picture


Trusted advisors are expected to see the big picture yet know the details. Cover more fields with
greater efficiency using data-driven insights about your growers and their crops.

[SEE HOW IT WORKS][46]

#### Strengthen your brand
#### and your teams

Create the best experience for every grower and every field, while we take care of the heavy lifting
with full, end-to-end service.

#### Detect and analyze
#### crop threats

Understand crop start, weed severity, disease, insect damage, and nutrient deficiencies—in season
and after the season.

#### Engage in a
#### personal way

Communicate with confidence, bringing visual, clear insights and action plans tailored specifically
to your growers.

Stand Counts
Weed Detection
Insect Damage
Nutrient Deficiencies
Disease Pressure
Field Health
High definition imagery so clear you can count the spots on a lady bug

## HOW TARANIS IS DIFFERENT

### Practical innovation born from a proud farming legacy


Taranis is leading the AI-powered crop intelligence revolution, combining high-end tech with expert
agronomy.

[SEE OUR INSIGHTS][47]

#### Year-round
#### coverage

Full service before, during, and after the season, backed by unmatched technology and deep ag
expertise.

#### Leaf-level
#### ground truth

Submillimeter image resolution of every acre, collected by drones and delivered right to your
fingertips—wherever you are.

#### Largest crop
#### imagery dataset

Deep AI and machine learning, trained by 500M+ data points and continuously optimized by our team of
experts.

## What our customers are saying

## Keep up with the latest from Taranis

[ ][48]

#### Secure USDA Funding: Join Taranis Conservation for a Free Webinar June 22 or 24

[Read more][49]
[ May 20, 2026 ][50]

#### Precision Agronomy Gets Smarter: Taranis and Syngenta Use AI-Powered Leaf Intelligence to
#### Transform Crop Management

The partnership between Taranis and Syngenta signals a broader shift in agricultural decision-making
—moving precision agronomy from field-level assessment to plant-level intelligence. At the center is
a growing effort to use artificial intelligence to reshape how retailers, agronomists, and growers
identify issues, allocate inputs, and measure outcomes.

[Read more][51]
[ ][52]

[Read more][53]

## **INTELA  LIFT  SYSTEMS**

Independent Row Lift
*Swath Control on Row Crop Cultivators*

## **Get the weed, leave the seed.**

The Intela Lift System is a unique, patent-pending system designed for row crop cultivators that
utilizes your existing monitor technology to raise and lower each row unit individually, to
successfully cultivate each row without disturbing existing crop.  Add swath control, or section
control to your existing field cultivator.


## **TECHNOLOGY**

The Intela Lift System, BH-100 Row Unit, works with your existing John Deer, 20/20 Precision
Planting, Ag Leader monitor and more.  

## **BENEFITS OF SECTION CONTROL**

Each row can raise independently, leaving crop undisturbed in irregular end rows; use your internal
boundaries to automatically raise up on waterways.  ROI is especially quicker for organic farming,
minimizing crop loss and maximizing bushels.
* No cultivating out point rows
* Remove weeds without creating bare spots for weeds to grow in end rows
* No need for headlands along waterways
* Eliminate erosion down end rows during heavy rain
* Extend the life of waterways
* Save time and money, up to $45 per acre* (See ROI section below)
* Easier on equipment
* No bouncing across bermed end rows at every waterway
* Better stewardship of the land

## **COMPATIBILITY**

Our Intela Lift Systems can be adapted to fit most rear-mount cultivators.  We can customize to fit
most cultivators.

## **APPLICATION**

Intela Lift Systems may be installed on your field cultivator, side dress bar, or other
applications.

## Intela Lift Systems - Return on Investment (ROI)

───┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Pi│*Savings of $45/acre is based on a square 40 acre field with a waterway at a 45° angle through  
ctu│the center. With end rows around the waterway, you would cultivate out 0.9 acres of corn.       
re]│                                                                                                
   │**SAVINGS CALCULATION:**                                                                        
   │* Retain 0.9 acres of corn                                                                      
   │* Based on 200 bushel organic corn at $10/bushel = $1800 in savings                             
   │* Divide by 40 acres = $45 savings per acre                                                     
   │                                                                                                
   │With the BH 100 - Intela Lift System, you won’t have to cultivate out any corn.  Also, you could
   │save more than an hour in time it would take to maintain end rows around the waterway.          
   │                                                                                                
   │**TIME SAVINGS:**                                                                               
   │* Planter pass = 10 min                                                                         
   │* 2 Rotary hoe passes = 5 min x 2                                                               
   │* 2 cultivation passes = 10 min x 2                                                             
   │* Harvesting pass = 20 mins                                                                     
───┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## Revolutionizing the farmer experience, online and onsite.

FarmerCore introduces more convenience for farmers by bringing the entire business to the farm,
putting them at the forefront of a customer-centric network that provides a seamless experience.

## Today’s challenges are tomorrow’s possibilities.

Our purpose at AGCO is to provide farmer-focused solutions to sustainably feed our world. Our
ambition is to accelerate innovation and efficiency to drive positive outcomes for farmers and the
planet.

At AGCO, we emphasize the importance of recognizing and honoring the individual experiences,
challenges and triumphs of farmers.

## AGCO. Where extraordinary grows.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do
for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work,
building a better and more sustainable world. Join us!

AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

# Check TON transactions and manage risks

TON Guard is the first cloud-based solution for the TON blockchain, leveraging AI-driven tools to
analyze wallets and transactions. Reduce manual efforts, financial risks, and protect your
business's reputation.

Check your wallet

## Game-Changing Solution

The platform is powered by advanced machine learning algorithms that continuously optimize and
enhance its capabilities.
* Real-time data
  update
* Detailed wallet
  statistics
* Data-driven
  Insights
* Fast API
  integration
* ## Advanced Risk Scorer
  
  It aids fintech companies and their AML officers in verifying TON addresses and making informed
  KYT decisions guided by data.
* ## Smart Visualizer
  
  This tool simplifies comprehensive investigations into crypto asset origins, transaction history,
  and destinations.
* ## Ongoing Monitoring
  
  This feature allows compliance officers to monitor AML risks and receive alerts for all specified
  addresses, using custom rules tailored to their risk policy
* ## Telegram Bot
  
  Risk assessment tool for everyone with Telegram bot interface
  
  [Start][7]
* ## Fast API integration
  
  This enables developers from any company to seamlessly integrate risk assessment functionality
  into their projects.

## Evaluate risks better

Discover effective detection of suspicious TON blockchain
transactions with our solutions.

## FAQ
* ### How is risk level determined in your system?
  
  The risk level is determined by evaluating multiple factors, such as transaction history, wallet
  behavior, and known fraudulent patterns. It provides insights into the likelihood of wallet
  involvement in dishonest activities within the TON blockchain.
* ### What kind of data sources does your system utilize for risk assessment?
  
  TON Guard leverages a variety of data sources for risk assessment. This includes transaction data
  from the TON blockchain, information provided by our clients' compliance departments, and
  open-source data about blockchain addresses, wallet types, and more. By incorporating multiple
  data sources, the accuracy and efficiency of the systemic risk assessment process are increased.
* ### How often is the risk assessment updated in your system?
  
  The system provides real-time risk assessment updates. As new transactions occur on the TON
  blockchain, developed algorithms continuously analyze and update the risk scores associated with
  wallets. This ensures that you have the latest information for well-informed decisions and swift
  actions.
* ### Can your system integrate with existing compliance and AML processes within my organization?
  
  TON Guard is designed to integrate with existing compliance and anti-money laundering (AML)
  processes by API and in personal accounts. It can work in conjunction with your organization's
  compliance departments, providing valuable insights to support risk management and regulatory
  compliance efforts.
* ### What should I do if my wallet has been assigned a high-risk level by your system, but I
  ### haven't engaged in any illegal activities?
  
  If your wallet has been assigned a high-risk level by TON Guard, it's important to understand that
  it indicates a probability of fraudulent activity rather than a confirmation of illegal
  involvement. We recommend contacting our support team via email at info@tonguard.com to review the
  assessment, provide any additional information, and address any concerns you may have.

### Tell us about you

# Manufacturer of Modern Agricultural
# Machinery and Equipment – Bourgault

 

Bourgault combines cutting-edge engineering with advanced technology to create next-generation
agricultural machinery. Our precision seeding, air seeding, and tillage systems are designed to help
farmers maximize efficiency, optimize yields, and embrace the future of smart farming.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][68]

Enterprise Solution


Esco Aster’s Enterprise Solutions offer a vertically integrated, one-stop framework for the
specialized design, construction, and validation of world-class life science and healthcare
facilities

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][69]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

[EXPLORE ][70]

## Our Offerings

Esco Aster provides variety of products and services based on best-in-class manufacturing platforms
with focus on new modalities.

We aim to provide the highest yield lowest cost with linearly scalable quality to better promote
healthcare access especially in the developing world, lower middle income countries.

##### Master Cell / Microbial Banking

Our cGMP-compliant cell bank can preserve a large volume of cell lines, microbial cells, and other
biologics for the manufacture of commercially available therapeutics.

We ensure that all samples collected either on the field or on our biobank are carefully processed
and transported using the best techniques for preservation.

##### Clinical Trial Material

We take part on several preclinical to clinical testing to determine efficacy of medical drugs and

Our dedicated scientist can serve as your partner from lead optimization to commercialization for

###### cGMP Process Development

##### cGMP Process Development

Apart from process equipment and turnkey facilities, we offer process development to support

includes cell culture medium optimization, seed preparation process development, and system layout
and process integration.

][73] [

###### MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences & Technology)

##### MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences & Technology)

We are able to provide fast, efficient and robust vaccine technology transfer with single-use
solutions, predictive process control, process scale up/scale down, complexity reduction, and

][74] [

###### Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Services

##### Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Services

We offer CDMO services to manufacture various grades of plasmid DNA for preclinical, clinical and

][75] [

###### Extracellular Vesicles

##### Extracellular Vesicles

Extracellular vesicles are secreted by many cells, of which the common ones are Mesenchymal Stromal

Leukocytes, platelets, cancer cells and even neural cells. They are classified into three groups

We leveraged on the Tide Motion bioreactors to establish a robust and scalable platform using

weather, satellites and our affordable sensors, you get a complete view of your fields. Any time,
anywhere.

[3 logos homepage website 3]

Join over 2250+ satisfied users

###### Easy-to-use platform

Data from scouting, weather, satellites and sensors comes together on one platform for a complete
overview of your fields.

[digital farming]

###### Affordable in-field sensors

Eight times more affordable than competitors, allowing mass deployment for more and accurate
information

[digital farming ]

###### Effortless API integration

The API easily connects our data and your existing systems for a smooth and easy data transfer
process

## Multiple Data Sources

### Valuable Insights collected 24/7

[icn 6]

##### Sensor

Network of low-cost soil sensors

[icn 11]

##### Field scouting

Up-to-date digital journal of your fields

[icn]

##### Satellite

Monitor large or remote areas

[icn 9]

##### Weather

Supplementary public weather data

[icn 2]

##### Soil

Type, temperature, texture and moisture

[icn 1]

##### Crop

Cultivation plans and overview

[precision farming]

### See critical field information on one central hub

Get quick access to the insights you need to optimise your farming operation. Our Farm21 dashboard
brings data from scouting, weather, satellite, crop and sensor information together – All in one
place.

[Learn More about our platform][38]

### Interpret data easily through our user-friendly interface

Optimise your day-to-day operations with data-driven decisions. A 360-degree view of your fields and
crops helps you to set irrigation, disease control and workforce priorities.

[Check out our solution][39]
[Farm21 sensor]

## Let’s grow together!

We’re providing an agri-data solution for growers, researchers, crop advisors and distributors:
* ##### “Essential for all crop advisors
  ##### and agri-consultants”
  
  > The Farm21 platform makes it easy for our crop and sales consultants to assist farmers remotely,
  > and at scale.  We’ve seen increased customer loyalty and higher customer retention.
  
  [Untitled design 14]
  André van der Weijde
  Commercial director CAV
* ##### “The affordable and effortless
  ##### agri-data solution”
  
  > We see first-hand how Farm21’s affordable soil sensors, along with their precision farming
  > platform, help our growers to make the transition to precise farming with ease and at minimal
  > investment.
  
  [Untitled design 13]
  Ko Francke
  CO-CEO CZAV
* ##### “I could act proactively
  ##### to prevent crop damage”
  
  > Thanks to the sensor, we have noticed that the air temperature at crop height can quickly warm
  > up to 15 degrees while the air temperature at 1,5m still indicates 12 to 13 degrees.
  
  [tulips 2022 04 22 12 58 40 utc]
  Pascal Alkemande
  Flower Grower

## Our sensors are affordable, robust, and easy to install.

With costs far lower than competing products, our soil moisture probes can be deployed at scale to
deliver more insights than ever before. Measuring up to 7 values with the default configuration, the
FS31 provides the most bang for buck on the market.

Designed from scratch by our product and hardware engineers for global operation and to withstand a
harsh outdoor environment.

[More about Our sensors][40][Visit Our Online Store][41]
[FS31 stand alone small 1]

## Farm21’s Sensor Advantages

[Group 107]

##### Robust Hardware

Treat, spray & irrigate crops with sensors in place

##### Long Lasting

Recharge battery with USB-C to last a full year on a single charge

software, empowering agribusinesses with advanced digital agriculture solutions. As a global leader
in farm business management software, we leverage cutting-edge technology to transform traditional
agricultural practices into a connected, data-driven ecosystem.
Designed for scalability, intelligence, and security, FarmERP serves as a single source of truth for
businesses—helping them meet food safety standards, sustainability goals, and climate challenges

In today’s fast-paced digital world, businesses must evolve to stay competitive. Digital
transformation is no longer optional—it’s a necessity for those aiming to scale, innovate, and
achieve exponential growth. By integrating cutting-edge technologies, data-driven strategies, and

## Global leaders in agribusiness ERP solutions

Having implemented farm business management software across 30+ countries, we bring extensive
expertise in optimizing agribusiness operations. Our strategic approach guarantees seamless
adoption, enabling businesses to harness farm data management software, streamline processes, and
gain full operational transparency.

## A future-ready tech stack

Our agriculture software solutions are powered by a trusted ERP system that serves as the backbone
of your business. By integrating all operations into a single farm management software platform, it
enhances efficiency, streamlines workflows, and enables real-time decision-making. With automation,
secure cloud access, and seamless department-wide integration, our ERP optimizes processes across
finance, inventory, sales, HR, planning, production, and packing—boosting productivity and
scalability.

## Instilling predictability in agribusiness landscape

As AI and ML reshape industries, predictability becomes a game-changer for sustainable growth.
FarmGyan, our advanced AI-powered agriculture software, enhances agribusiness decision-making by
converting complex data into precise, actionable insights. Seamlessly integrated with FarmERP’s
smart farming solutions, FarmGyan optimizes crop productivity and business efficiency. Powered by
high-accuracy models trained on millions of data points, FarmGyan’s advanced models are available as
ready-to-use APIs, making precision-driven agribusiness IT solutions more accessible than ever.

[about-us]

In the dynamic landscape of agriculture, smart precision farming has emerged as an essential
lifeline for farmers facing the challenges of a growing global population, dwindling water
resources, and the unpredictable impacts of climate change. Among innovative software and high-tech
equipment, tractor GPS tools claim the top spot.

Imagine GPS as the central hub, akin to a WiFi router, connecting all critical devices on the farm.
This remarkable technology doesn't just offer impressive accuracy; it unlocks a world of other
possibilities for farmers:
* Farm Mapping: Chart field boundaries and tag unique features like rocks and pits, creating an
  accurate representation of your landscape.
* Control Hub: Gain invaluable insights into machinery operations, routes, mileage, coverage area,
  fuel consumption, downtime, and more.
* GPS-RTK Technology: Elevate field operations, from seeding to spreading, by ensuring impeccable
  rows with zero gaps or overlaps. This not only boosts efficiency but also preserves valuable
  resources and time.

**Pioneering Precision at Your Fingertips**

One of the most remarkable advancements in precision farming is the tractor autosteer, seamlessly
integrated with GPS technology. This game-changing innovation automates the meticulous task of
creating precise rows – a skill previously demanding the utmost expertise and focus from manual
operators. With a GPS unit on your tractor, signals from satellites plot the optimal course, but for
unmatched precision, the RTK system takes the stage. It minimizes signal interference, refining
automatic steering accuracy to within +- 1cm. Signals are received from nearby RTK stations or your

[about-us]

In the dynamic landscape of agriculture, smart precision farming has emerged as an essential
lifeline for farmers facing the challenges of a growing global population, dwindling water
resources, and the unpredictable impacts of climate change. Among innovative software and high-tech
equipment, tractor GPS tools claim the top spot.

Imagine GPS as the central hub, akin to a WiFi router, connecting all critical devices on the farm.
This remarkable technology doesn't just offer impressive accuracy; it unlocks a world of other
possibilities for farmers:
* Farm Mapping: Chart field boundaries and tag unique features like rocks and pits, creating an
  accurate representation of your landscape.
* Control Hub: Gain invaluable insights into machinery operations, routes, mileage, coverage area,
  fuel consumption, downtime, and more.
* GPS-RTK Technology: Elevate field operations, from seeding to spreading, by ensuring impeccable
  rows with zero gaps or overlaps. This not only boosts efficiency but also preserves valuable
  resources and time.

**Pioneering Precision at Your Fingertips**

One of the most remarkable advancements in precision farming is the tractor autosteer, seamlessly
integrated with GPS technology. This game-changing innovation automates the meticulous task of
creating precise rows – a skill previously demanding the utmost expertise and focus from manual
operators. With a GPS unit on your tractor, signals from satellites plot the optimal course, but for
unmatched precision, the RTK system takes the stage. It minimizes signal interference, refining
automatic steering accuracy to within +- 1cm. Signals are received from nearby RTK stations or your
dedicated RTK base. The synergy of GPS and RTK precision agriculture tools streamlines your
fieldwork, amplifying efficiency and cost-effectiveness, leaving you with more time and resources
for vital tasks.

In the realm of precision farming, GPS technology is a non-negotiable asset for tractors. At
FieldBee, we specialize in precision farming supplies, rooted in GPS and RTK technologies, designed
for tractors, harvesters, and all farming machinery. Discover the remarkable advantages of this
technology on our website, and empower your farm for a more prosperous future.

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical
sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology,
components and comprehensive services. Guided by a strong sense of purpose, our more than 18,000
dedicated employees work to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes

# Engineering for a better world

We engineer resource-efficient solutions for a better world and to support the sustainability goals
of our customers. And we promote the highest environmental and social standards at our own sites and
in procurement. We aim to become the most attractive employer in the engineering industry with
greater diversity, equal opportunity and integration, and by offering long-term career development
prospects. To make these ambitions concrete, we have defined measurable ESG targets as part of GEA’s
Mission 30 strategy.

### GEA Annual General Meeting approves dividend increase and re-elects Supervisory Board Chairman
### Prof. Dieter Kempf

At today’s Annual General Meeting, the shareholders of GEA Group AG approved all resolutions
proposed by the Supervisory Board and the Executive Board by a large majority. The dividend will be
increased from EUR 1.15 to EUR 1.30 per share. Professor Dieter Kempf was re-elected as Chairman of
the Supervisory Board for another year.

## Who we work with

Fostering the global adoption of safer and more responsible farming practices is a collective
effort, which is why GLOBALG.A.P. works with a global network of stakeholder parties. Through
working groups, capacity-building partners, and more than 440 member organizations from all sides of
the value chain in our GLOBALG.A.P. community, we strive to connect with as many contributors as
possible.

# Thank you to all our GLOBALG.A.P. Community Members for your support!

From major retailers to independent agricultural consultants, all our community members provide
valuable insights and support in improving our solutions.
[ Explore community membership ][94]

### Working with GLOBALG.A.P standards since 1997, I have seen the change they’ve brought – not only
### from the food safety perspective that is so important to consumers, but also as a practical tool
### that helps improve social and environmental aspects in the lives of smallholders all over the
### world.

Manal Saleh

Founder and General Manager of Blue Moon LLC and Associate GLOBALG.A.P. Community Member | Egypt

# GGN label

The GGN label is a cross-category consumer label that stands for certified, responsible farming and
transparency. Applicable to fruit and vegetables, farmed seafood, and flowers and plants which have
been produced in line with GLOBALG.A.P. standards, the GGN label helps you improve your competitive
edge and grow trust in your brand by making responsible farming visible on store shelves.
[ Join the GGN label initiative ][95]

Vannamei Shrimp/ Golda Prawn / Tiger Shrimp / Fish Farming Zero Water Discharge RAS Water Treatment
Plant/ Recirculation aquaculture systems represent a new and unique way to farm Prawn / Fish. These
systems are used all around the world for the production of many Prawn / Fish species in a more
efficient controlled environment. Currently Zero Water Discharge RAS is one of the fastest growing
sectors of agriculture in Bangladesh. Growing public demand for a healthy, tasty and affordable
Prawn / Fish is stimulating the "boom" in RAS Aquaculture Industry & Pond RAS Fish Culture Industry.

RAS offer Prawn / Fish producers a variety of important advantages over open pond culture. These
include a method to maximize production on a limited supply of water and land, nearly complete
environmental control to maximize Prawn / Fish growth year-round, the flexibility to locate
production facilities near large markets, complete and convenient harvesting, and quick and
effective disease control.

RAS can be of various sizes ranging from large-scale production systems (over 1 million pounds per
year) to intermediate-sized systems (500,000 pounds per year), to small systems (50,000 pounds per
year). They can be used as grow-out systems to produce food Prawn/Fish or as hatcheries to produce
eggs and fingerling sport Prawn/Fish for stocking and ornamental Prawn/Fish for home aquariums.

In the past few years, potential to grow Prawn/Fish on a commercial-scale been realized. New water
quality technology, testing and monitoring instrumentation, and computer enhanced system design
programs, much of it developed for the waste water treatment industry, have been incorporated and
have revolutionized our ability to grow Prawn/Fish in Tank/Pond culture. RAS application will be
more reliable, profitable, and meet the demand of aquatic enterprise.

Vannamei Shrimp/ Golda Prawn / Tiger Shrimp / Fish Farming Zero Water Discharge RAS Water Treatment
Plant/ Recirculation aquaculture systems represent a new and unique way to farm Prawn / Fish. These
systems are used all around the world for the production of many Prawn / Fish species in a more
efficient controlled environment. Currently Zero Water Discharge RAS is one of the fastest growing
sectors of agriculture in Bangladesh. Growing public demand for a healthy, tasty and affordable
Prawn / Fish is stimulating the "boom" in RAS Aquaculture Industry & Pond RAS Fish Culture Industry.

RAS offer Prawn / Fish producers a variety of important advantages over open pond culture. These
include a method to maximize production on a limited supply of water and land, nearly complete
environmental control to maximize Prawn / Fish growth year-round, the flexibility to locate
production facilities near large markets, complete and convenient harvesting, and quick and
effective disease control.

RAS can be of various sizes ranging from large-scale production systems (over 1 million pounds per
year) to intermediate-sized systems (500,000 pounds per year), to small systems (50,000 pounds per
year). They can be used as grow-out systems to produce food Prawn/Fish or as hatcheries to produce
eggs and fingerling sport Prawn/Fish for stocking and ornamental Prawn/Fish for home aquariums.

In the past few years, potential to grow Prawn/Fish on a commercial-scale been realized. New water
quality technology, testing and monitoring instrumentation, and computer enhanced system design
programs, much of it developed for the waste water treatment industry, have been incorporated and
have revolutionized our ability to grow Prawn/Fish in Tank/Pond culture. RAS application will be
more reliable, profitable, and meet the demand of aquatic enterprise.

## About KisaanMitrr - India's Best Agriculture Consulting Company

Kisaanmitrr is a full-service top agriculture consulting company in India. We provide unique,
innovative, sustainable and well-researched solutions for farmers to accelerate their growth. Our
services include project planning and development, turn-key implementation, providing support in
value delivery, finding out additional markets for products and getting the farmers the best price.
We focus on result driven, tailormade solutions with a growth and sustainability mindset. Our
farming consulting business helps farmers make better decisions when it comes to the crops they
should plant, by providing them with a variety of options that best suit the climate, water levels,
and market requirement specific to their geography.

We have tie-ups with multiple Indian conglomerates who provide steady requirements for the farm
products at the most optimal rates. KisaanMitrr works with farmers, government agencies, local,
national, and international businesses to optimize your ROI. We’re easily rated among the top
agriculture consulting firms in India.

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

Math AI is an AI-powered math problem solver that seamlessly blends advanced artificial intelligence

delivering step-by-step solutions and clear explanations to help students excel in mathematics at
any level.

Yes, Math AI offers a free version that allows you to solve a limited number of problems. For
advanced features and unlimited solutions, we offer premium plans starting at a small monthly fee.

### What types of mathematical problems can Math AI solve?

Math AI can handle a wide range of mathematical topics including algebra, calculus, statistics,
geometry, trigonometry, and more. From basic arithmetic to complex calculus problems, Our Math AI
Solver is trained to provide step-by-step solutions.

### How accurate are the solutions?

Math AI uses advanced AI algorithms trained on millions of mathematical problems to ensure high
accuracy. Our AI math solver is constantly learning and improving, and we verify solutions through
multiple methods to maintain accuracy.

Math AI is designed as a learning tool that provides step-by-step explanations to help you

encourage using it responsibly as a study aid rather than a homework completion tool.

We focus on providing detailed step-by-step explanations that help you learn, not just get answers.
Plus, our image recognition technology makes it easier to input complex equations.

Absolutely! Math AI is fully optimized for mobile use. You can easily take photos of your problems
using smartphone camera or type equations on any device. Our responsive design ensures a seamless
experience across all platforms.

### Can Math AI handle complex calculus and advanced mathematics?

Yes, Math AI excels at advanced mathematics including calculus, differential equations, linear
algebra, and more. Maths AI is trained on university-level mathematics and can handle complex
integration, differentiation, limits, and other advanced topics.

### How does Math AI compare to using regular ChatGPT for math problems?

While ChatGPT can handle basic math problems, Math AI is specifically designed and optimized for
mathematical problem-solving. Our math AI uses specialized algorithms trained on millions of math
problems, making it more accurate and comprehensive than general ChatGPT for math. Math AI also
includes features like photo recognition, step-by-step explanations, and a math-focused interface
that regular ChatGPT doesn't offer.

### Can I use Math AI as a replacement for traditional math learning methods?

Math AI serves as an excellent supplementary tool to traditional learning methods. While our math
solver provide instant solutions and explanations, they work best when used alongside regular study
practices. Maths solver can help verify your work, provide alternative solution methods, and offer
detailed explanations, making it an invaluable companion to your mathematical education journey.

## Application

### Agricultural Machinery and Accessories

Agricultural machinery is widely used to improve agricultural productivity and crop yields. Key
applications include tillage (plows, harrows), seeding (strip seeders, hole seeders), plant
protection (sprayers), irrigation (sprinklers, drip irrigation), harvesting (combine harvesters),
drying (grain dryers), straw handling (balers, shredders), fruit tree management (pruners, pickers),
and smart agriculture (driverless tractors, monitoring systems). These highly efficient and
multi-functional agricultural equipment are the key to modern agricultural production.

## Application

### Agricultural Machinery and Accessories

Agricultural machinery is widely used to improve agricultural productivity and crop yields. Key
applications include tillage (plows, harrows), seeding (strip seeders, hole seeders), plant
protection (sprayers), irrigation (sprinklers, drip irrigation), harvesting (combine harvesters),
drying (grain dryers), straw handling (balers, shredders), fruit tree management (pruners, pickers),
and smart agriculture (driverless tractors, monitoring systems). These highly efficient and
multi-functional agricultural equipment are the key to modern agricultural production.

# Award-Winning Global Seeding Machinery Manufacturer Since 1976

Our journey began four generations ago in 1956 as a humble cottage industry in a nearby
village—before tractors even entered Indian agriculture. National Agro Industries was formally
established in Ludhiana in 1976, where we continue to thrive today. From the beginning, our path has
been defined by innovation and a strong commitment to sustainable and regenerative agriculture.

An award-winning manufacturer and trusted exporter we specialize in seed drills and precision
planters for modern mechanized farming.

As an ISO-certified company ( TÜV Rheinland Germany, since 2003 ), we follow strict international
quality standards, ensuring durability, consistency, and high performance.

Our machinery supports 5,000+ seed varieties, making it suitable for diverse crops and farming
conditions. Our solutions are trusted in 80+ countries, supported by a 130+ dealer network across
India and international markets, with 70+ models designed for precision and efficiency.

We focus on delivering equipment that offers:
* High performance and precision sowing
* Easy operation and low maintenance
* Long-term durability
* Fuel and cost efficiency
* spare parts availability and a strong after-sales support system

We welcome inquiries from international distributors, dealers, and agricultural partners worldwide.

**Empowering agriculture with innovation, precision, durability, and trust.**

### What Makes National Agro Industries the Preferred Choice of Farmers

Whether you are a farmer, dealer, or institution, National Agro Industries provides high
performance, reliable machinery designed to boost efficiency, save resources, and increase
profitability. Trusted across India and beyond, our innovative solutions are transforming
agriculture—discover why so many are making the switch today.

Farmers, dealers, and institutions alike trust National Agro Industries for machinery that delivers
results. Experience the technology that’s changing agriculture and see the difference for yourself.

#### Why Farmers Trust National Agro Seed Drills
* Consistent Performance: Ensures reliable crop yields.
* Built to Last: Durable design for long-term use.
* Easy to Use: Saves time and effort in the field.
* Proven Technology: Trusted by generations of farmers.

[Lets Chat][54] [Call Now][55]

### Sowing Methods

At National Agro, we support all major sowing methods to meet the diverse needs of farmers:
**Flat Sowing :** Seeds are sown directly on leveled soil, suitable for crops like wheat, barley,
and pulses.
**Ridge Sowing :** Seeds are planted on raised ridges, improving water management and root
development, ideal for crops like maize and soybean.
**Bed Sowing :** Seeds are sown on raised beds, enhancing soil aeration, drainage, and crop health,
perfect for vegetables, cotton, and other row crops.

### Sowing Tines

Our seed drills can be equipped with a wide range of seeding tines, designed to perform efficiently
across diverse soil conditions and farming practices worldwide. With over 70+ types of seed drills
and planters, we cater to different geographical regions including Asia, Africa, Europe, USA and
Australia & more.

Choose the ideal tine based on your soil type:

**Conventional Seeding Tines – **Best suited for well-prepared, loose soils where traditional
tillage has already been performed.
**Minimum Tillage Tines – **Ideal for medium to firm soils with moderate residue, helping retain
soil moisture and soil structure.
**No-Tillage Tines – **Designed for undisturbed soils with heavy crop residue, allowing direct
seeding without prior land preparation while preserving moisture and reducing erosion.
**Tillage Tines – **Suitable for hard, compact, or uncultivated soils, ensuring deep penetration and
proper seed placement.

# Award-Winning Global Seeding Machinery Manufacturer Since 1976

Our journey began four generations ago in 1956 as a humble cottage industry in a nearby
village—before tractors even entered Indian agriculture. National Agro Industries was formally
established in Ludhiana in 1976, where we continue to thrive today. From the beginning, our path has
been defined by innovation and a strong commitment to sustainable and regenerative agriculture.

An award-winning manufacturer and trusted exporter we specialize in seed drills and precision
planters for modern mechanized farming.

As an ISO-certified company ( TÜV Rheinland Germany, since 2003 ), we follow strict international
quality standards, ensuring durability, consistency, and high performance.

Our machinery supports 5,000+ seed varieties, making it suitable for diverse crops and farming
conditions. Our solutions are trusted in 80+ countries, supported by a 130+ dealer network across
India and international markets, with 70+ models designed for precision and efficiency.

We focus on delivering equipment that offers:
* High performance and precision sowing
* Easy operation and low maintenance
* Long-term durability
* Fuel and cost efficiency
* spare parts availability and a strong after-sales support system

We welcome inquiries from international distributors, dealers, and agricultural partners worldwide.

**Empowering agriculture with innovation, precision, durability, and trust.**

### What Makes National Agro Industries the Preferred Choice of Farmers

Whether you are a farmer, dealer, or institution, National Agro Industries provides high
performance, reliable machinery designed to boost efficiency, save resources, and increase
profitability. Trusted across India and beyond, our innovative solutions are transforming
agriculture—discover why so many are making the switch today.

Farmers, dealers, and institutions alike trust National Agro Industries for machinery that delivers
results. Experience the technology that’s changing agriculture and see the difference for yourself.

#### Why Farmers Trust National Agro Seed Drills
* Consistent Performance: Ensures reliable crop yields.
* Built to Last: Durable design for long-term use.
* Easy to Use: Saves time and effort in the field.
* Proven Technology: Trusted by generations of farmers.

[Lets Chat][54] [Call Now][55]

### Sowing Methods

At National Agro, we support all major sowing methods to meet the diverse needs of farmers:
**Flat Sowing :** Seeds are sown directly on leveled soil, suitable for crops like wheat, barley,
and pulses.
**Ridge Sowing :** Seeds are planted on raised ridges, improving water management and root
development, ideal for crops like maize and soybean.
**Bed Sowing :** Seeds are sown on raised beds, enhancing soil aeration, drainage, and crop health,
perfect for vegetables, cotton, and other row crops.

### Sowing Tines

Our seed drills can be equipped with a wide range of seeding tines, designed to perform efficiently
across diverse soil conditions and farming practices worldwide. With over 70+ types of seed drills
and planters, we cater to different geographical regions including Asia, Africa, Europe, USA and
Australia & more.

Choose the ideal tine based on your soil type:

**Conventional Seeding Tines – **Best suited for well-prepared, loose soils where traditional
tillage has already been performed.
**Minimum Tillage Tines – **Ideal for medium to firm soils with moderate residue, helping retain
soil moisture and soil structure.
**No-Tillage Tines – **Designed for undisturbed soils with heavy crop residue, allowing direct
seeding without prior land preparation while preserving moisture and reducing erosion.
**Tillage Tines – **Suitable for hard, compact, or uncultivated soils, ensuring deep penetration and
proper seed placement.

Satellite-powered intelligence for modern agriculture - from field monitoring and variable-rate
application maps to crop identification across entire countries. Used by 140,000+ farmers and global
agriculture leaders.

We built an AI that reads every field, every day — cross-referencing satellite signals, weather, and
crop calendar — and delivers one ranked list of what needs attention today.

## The Philbro range, in motion

A 20-second look at Philfry, Sunphil and Arielle — from the factory floor to the table.

Business Sectors

## An integrated agro-industrial group.

Philbro Oil sits across five linked sectors — refining, packaging, agricultural sourcing, trade and
export, and renewable energy. The combination is what makes it possible to offer competitive
Ghana-made cooking oil at scale.
* From fresh palm fruit bunches to refined edible oils.
  
  ### Oil Processing & Refining
  
  A planned 100-tonne-per-day screw oil mill and refinery in Kyekyerew, Eastern Region, designed to
  process fresh palm fruit bunches into refined palm oil and palm kernel oil for household,
  foodservice, industrial, and export use.
  
  [Explore sector→][48]
  * Planned 100 TPD screw oil mill
  * Continuous refining line designed for consistent FFA, colour, and peroxide control
  * Designed for solar-supported 24-hour operations
  * Bulk and packaged output for local and export channels
* Food-grade HDPE bottles, blown in-house.
  
  ### Packaging Manufacturing
  
  A planned in-house HDPE blow-moulding line at Kyekyerew to produce food-grade bottles. Bringing
  packaging in-house lets Philbro Oil control quality, lead time, and unit cost from preform to
  finished bottle.
  
  [Explore sector→][49]
  * Food-grade HDPE bottle blow moulding
  * Multiple pack formats — 500 ml through 25 L jerry can
  * Reduces dependency on third-party converters
  * Tighter quality control on neck finish, wall thickness, and labelling
* 20,000+ smallholder farmer partners.
  
  ### Agricultural Value Chain
  
  Philbro Oil sources from a network of more than 20,000 smallholder farmers across Ghana's oil palm
  belt, supported by guaranteed market access, fair farmgate pricing, and agricultural extension
  support, alongside owned and managed plantation acreage.
  
  [Explore sector→][50]
  * 20,000+ smallholder farmer partners
  * Guaranteed market access for harvested bunches
  * Fair farmgate pricing and prompt payment cycles
  * Agricultural extension and best-practice support
* ECOWAS and AfCFTA-ready Ghana-origin supply.
  
  ### Export & Trade
  
  Philbro Oil is built for export. The Kyekyerew refinery is designed for the ECOWAS regional market
  and the African Continental Free Trade Area, with documentation, packaging, and logistics
  workflows tailored to cross-border edible oil trade.
  
  [Explore sector→][51]
  * ECOWAS and AfCFTA market positioning
  * Bulk and packaged export formats
  * Distributor and private-label support
  * Ghana-origin product story for export buyers
* A planned 1 MW solar system to power the refinery.
  
  ### Renewable Energy
  
  A planned 1 MW solar power system at Kyekyerew, designed to support 24-hour, lower-carbon
  manufacturing. Solar reduces grid dependence, stabilises production cost, and aligns Philbro Oil
  with Ghana's climate-smart industrial agenda.
  
  [Explore sector→][52]
  * Planned 1 MW on-site solar system
  * Designed for 24-hour refinery operations
  * Lower projected emissions per litre of oil refined
  * Aligned to Ghana's climate-smart industry agenda

[Aerial view of the Kyekyerew refinery construction site in Eastern Region, Ghana]

Solar Refinery · Kyekyerew · Under construction

## A refinery rising in the Eastern Region.

The Kyekyerew project is a planned 100-tonne-per-day refinery with in-house HDPE blow-moulding and a
planned 1 MW on-site solar system. It is designed for 24-hour, lower-carbon production — import
substitution, food security, smallholder farmer income, and Ghana-origin export supply for ECOWAS
and AfCFTA.

[Explore the project][53][Partner with us][54]

Sustainability & Community

## Rural prosperity is the business model.

Philbro's value chain is built around 20,000-plus smallholder farmer partners — with guaranteed
market access, fair farmgate pricing, and agricultural extension support. The Kyekyerew refinery
extends that promise into manufacturing jobs and a planned renewable-energy production base.
* Farmer income
  
  Guaranteed offtake for more than 20,000 smallholder farmer partners. Fair farmgate prices and
  prompt payment cycles support household income across rural Ghana.
* Food security
  
  Local refining substitutes for imported oil and stabilises supply during foreign-exchange and
  shipping shocks.
* Rural jobs
  
  The Kyekyerew project is designed to support a planned 350 direct jobs plus indirect employment
  across logistics, aggregation, and field extension.
* Lower-carbon production
  
  The refinery is designed for a planned 1 MW solar system, reducing projected emissions per litre
  of refined oil. Carbon performance will be reported only after verified measurement.
* Community standing
  
  Philbro Oil operates as a community member in Oyarifa and Kyekyerew — engaging traditional
  authorities, hiring locally, and contributing to local development.

Our Story · Since 2009

## One processing unit in Oyarifa. A refinery rising in Kyekyerew.

Philbro Oil Enterprise was founded on 13 March 2009 in Oyarifa, Accra by Mr. Philip Kwame Brobbey —
a Ghanaian-owned manufacturer determined to refine cooking oil at home rather than import it. From
that first unit, Philbro grew the Philfry and PB brands across household and trade channels, built a
20,000-plus smallholder farmer network, and is now constructing a planned 100 TPD solar-powered
refinery in Kyekyerew, Eastern Region.

Business Sectors

## An integrated agro-industrial group.

Philbro Oil sits across five linked sectors — refining, packaging, agricultural sourcing, trade and
export, and renewable energy. The combination is what makes it possible to offer competitive
Ghana-made cooking oil at scale.
* From fresh palm fruit bunches to refined edible oils.
  
  ### Oil Processing & Refining
  
  A planned 100-tonne-per-day screw oil mill and refinery in Kyekyerew, Eastern Region, designed to
  process fresh palm fruit bunches into refined palm oil and palm kernel oil for household,
  foodservice, industrial, and export use.
  
  [Explore sector→][48]
  * Planned 100 TPD screw oil mill
  * Continuous refining line designed for consistent FFA, colour, and peroxide control
  * Designed for solar-supported 24-hour operations
  * Bulk and packaged output for local and export channels
* Food-grade HDPE bottles, blown in-house.
  
  ### Packaging Manufacturing
  
  A planned in-house HDPE blow-moulding line at Kyekyerew to produce food-grade bottles. Bringing
  packaging in-house lets Philbro Oil control quality, lead time, and unit cost from preform to
  finished bottle.
  
  [Explore sector→][49]
  * Food-grade HDPE bottle blow moulding
  * Multiple pack formats — 500 ml through 25 L jerry can
  * Reduces dependency on third-party converters
  * Tighter quality control on neck finish, wall thickness, and labelling
* 20,000+ smallholder farmer partners.
  
  ### Agricultural Value Chain
  
  Philbro Oil sources from a network of more than 20,000 smallholder farmers across Ghana's oil palm
  belt, supported by guaranteed market access, fair farmgate pricing, and agricultural extension
  support, alongside owned and managed plantation acreage.
  
  [Explore sector→][50]
  * 20,000+ smallholder farmer partners
  * Guaranteed market access for harvested bunches
  * Fair farmgate pricing and prompt payment cycles
  * Agricultural extension and best-practice support
* ECOWAS and AfCFTA-ready Ghana-origin supply.
  
  ### Export & Trade
  
  Philbro Oil is built for export. The Kyekyerew refinery is designed for the ECOWAS regional market
  and the African Continental Free Trade Area, with documentation, packaging, and logistics
  workflows tailored to cross-border edible oil trade.
  
  [Explore sector→][51]
  * ECOWAS and AfCFTA market positioning
  * Bulk and packaged export formats
  * Distributor and private-label support
  * Ghana-origin product story for export buyers
* A planned 1 MW solar system to power the refinery.
  
  ### Renewable Energy
  
  A planned 1 MW solar power system at Kyekyerew, designed to support 24-hour, lower-carbon
  manufacturing. Solar reduces grid dependence, stabilises production cost, and aligns Philbro Oil
  with Ghana's climate-smart industrial agenda.
  
  [Explore sector→][52]
  * Planned 1 MW on-site solar system
  * Designed for 24-hour refinery operations
  * Lower projected emissions per litre of oil refined
  * Aligned to Ghana's climate-smart industry agenda

[Aerial view of the Kyekyerew refinery construction site in Eastern Region, Ghana]

Solar Refinery · Kyekyerew · Under construction

## A refinery rising in the Eastern Region.

The Kyekyerew project is a planned 100-tonne-per-day refinery with in-house HDPE blow-moulding and a
planned 1 MW on-site solar system. It is designed for 24-hour, lower-carbon production — import
substitution, food security, smallholder farmer income, and Ghana-origin export supply for ECOWAS
and AfCFTA.

Sustainability & Community

## Rural prosperity is the business model.

Philbro's value chain is built around 20,000-plus smallholder farmer partners — with guaranteed
market access, fair farmgate pricing, and agricultural extension support. The Kyekyerew refinery
extends that promise into manufacturing jobs and a planned renewable-energy production base.
* Farmer income
  
  Guaranteed offtake for more than 20,000 smallholder farmer partners. Fair farmgate prices and
  prompt payment cycles support household income across rural Ghana.
* Food security
  
  Local refining substitutes for imported oil and stabilises supply during foreign-exchange and
  shipping shocks.
* Rural jobs
  
  The Kyekyerew project is designed to support a planned 350 direct jobs plus indirect employment
  across logistics, aggregation, and field extension.
* Lower-carbon production
  
  The refinery is designed for a planned 1 MW solar system, reducing projected emissions per litre
  of refined oil. Carbon performance will be reported only after verified measurement.
* Community standing
  
  Philbro Oil operates as a community member in Oyarifa and Kyekyerew — engaging traditional
  authorities, hiring locally, and contributing to local development.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team.
