## Precision ag

## is Australia’s Leading provider of variable rate farming solutions.

Today, Australian farmers are faced with familiar challenges:
* Escalating **production expenses** due to rising labour rates, increased costs for chemicals,
  water, freight and nutrients
* **Variation in paddock** performance
* **Increasing land value** prices
* Greenhouse gas **compliance demands**

These issues have triggered the adoption of variable rate technology.

[About PRECISION AG][25]
[
][26]


Soil is one of earth’s most important natural resources. Healthy soils are the lifeblood, of clean
plentiful water, and air.

In agriculture, **the real value is not in the number of hectares, but in the health of the soil.**

Because healthy soils, are productive soils.

### unlock your soil’s potential

###### 1

###### Develop A Soil
###### Management Plan

We will meet you and/or your agronomist/farm advisor to identify soil issues and constraints. We
will then assess, prioritise and develop a Soil Management Plan to suit your business and budget

###### 2

###### Select Sampling
###### Method

We choose the right tool for the right job.

We decide on grid or strategic soil sampling. We may create management zones using EM38 & Gamma
technologies.

###### 3

###### SOIL TESTS CONDUCTED AT NATA CERTIFIED LAB

Accurate results are important and we use a certified NATA laboratory.

###### 4

###### Produce VR Application maps

Our industry leading platform – Soli – will process the soil laboratory results at speed, and
produce clear, actionable insights including spatial results.

###### 5

###### Generate “Plug and Play” Prescription Files

With your targets set, our platform – Soli – can generate plug and play files for any farm
controller so your prescription file will work seamlessly.

We can even load it onto your controller remotely.

###### 6

###### Review annually

We recommend reviewing your results and soil management plan annually to ensure you maximise the
benefits of your program.

## Reduce Costs,

## Improve Yields.

#### Throughout 15 years of soil sampling and variable rate mapping, we’ve seen:
* Reduction of lime inputs by up to 60%
* Reduction of phosphorus inputs by up to 25%
* Reduction of nitrogen inputs by up to 50%
* Better environmental outcomes through lower GHG emissions

[
][27]

#### Complex data simplified

## Your soil data safely secured in one location

## Clear visuals of paddocks

## Easy identification of problem areas

## Assist with future soil sampling and fertiliser needs

## Generate your own variable rate maps

## Generate prescription files

[Learn More][28]

### Testimonials

Soil is where everything happens, it’s where our bank of resources is, it’s where all the potential
of the crop lies, yet it’s the thing we know the least about.

### Tim Rethus

## Broadacre Farmer

Once you’ve got your map, you can just go in with your normal spreader at different rates with a
google earth print out in your cabin and adjust rates as you go.

### Redbank Farming

## Horticulture

Our questions are answered straight away, we get service at the door. We feel like they’re part of
our business and we hope that they feel like we’re part of theirs.

### Bob Douglas

## Spreading Contractors

We’ve been able to target particular problems and ground truth them.

### Scott Hutchings

## Senior Agronomist

The money saving with our lime applications alone justifies our investments with Precision Ag.

### Schreurs & Sons

## Horticulture Farmer

The main thing to start with is just highlighting the issues. There’s different problems in
different paddocks and there’s so many areas we can improve because of variability in paddock. It’s
a learning process.

### Matt Witney

## Agronomist

It’s a product anyone can use. You don’t need to understand it, you just plug it into the computer
and drive. This is really helpful when you have numerous operators through that driver’s seat.

### Charlie Vallance

## Broadacre Farmer

I just ring them up and they upload it to the iPad in the tractor, and it’s that easy. It’s hard to
believe how easy it is.

### Andrew Fraser

## Broadacre Farmer

[View All Testimonials][29]

Recirculation aquaculture systems (RAS) represent a new and unique way to mud crab and shrimp fish
farm . These Ras systems are used all around the world for the production of many crab and shrimp
fish species in a more efficient controlled environment. Currently Recirculation aquaculture
systems- RAS is one of the fastest growing sectors of agriculture business in Bangladesh. Growing
public demand for a healthy, tasty and affordable mud crab fish is stimulating the "boom" in RAS mud
crab and shrimp fish industry.


### How to Zero Water Concept RAS Technology?


Aquaculture System: Zero Water Discharge for Vannamei Shrimp and Prawn Farming in Bangladesh

The ZDRAS is a land-based fully-closed aquaculture system based on a recirculation technology
cycling water through filtration processes and returning it back to the system without discharging
any waste to the surrounding environment. Zero discharge RAS water treatment plant- ZDRAS has easier
the technique by using HDPE Geomembrane pond liner.

# Introducing the New Generation

[Find a Dealer][21]

## Engineered with quality, dependability, and pride

We believe in high quality design and machine performance that positively impacts your business’
bottom line. Our team works hand in hand with our dealers to ensure that all ideas are brought
directly from the field to our engineers. We never settle for less and strive to make thoughtful,
productive, and uncompromising machines.

[Why RBR][22]

## Built to last. Built for fast.

## STRONG FROM THE START

Our frames are made from high-grade steel and are fully boxed with secondary reinforcement plates
for added strength. We finish them with a polyurea armor coating to ensure superior protection and
maximize the life of your equipment.

## POWERED BY PERFORMANCE

We’ve installed the best powertrain package combination for maximum gains from your investment. The
Cummins 9-liter engine and RDS Allison transmission bring the power, torque, and worry-free
operation you need to tackle any field.

## STRAIGHTFORWARD SIMPLICITY

The mechanical drive train is a straightforward, no-frills design that offers reliability, lower
cost of ownership and unsurpassed performance. The 2-speed transfer case delivers maximum power to
both axles, allowing you to attack the adverse field conditions.

## ENJOY THE RIDE

Gas shocks and air suspensions provide an all-day comfortable ride for application speeds and
protection from the toughest terrain.

[ See all products ][23]

## Our Products

[Vector 390]

### Vector

Our Vector models are the most productive applicators available. The straight-forward design is made
with the highest grade components for a top-tier performance you can count on. Designed for use
during pre-plant and post-plant season, maximize the return on investment all year long.

### Vector

[Vector 390][24]
[Vector 430][25]
[Venturi 430]

### Venturi

The Venturi delivers with high-output pneumatic systems, for precision application, even in the most
unfavorable conditions. Product is accurately placed directly on the ground through individual boom
outlets, unaffected by uneven ground or windy conditions.

### Venturi

[Venturi 430][26]
[Vortex 390]

### Vortex

Designed with efficiency in mind, the Vortex covers more ground and maximizes ROI with large
capacity gallon tank and boom options. The center rack increases the life of the booms and the added
display at the loading station allows for a one-touch operation that controls valves and the
cleaning system.

### Vortex

[Vortex 390][27]

## Serving Farmers

> “The main benefits have been the dependability of the machine, being able to go to the field and
> know that the job is going to get done!” — Logan Davis – Naylor Agri

## Productivity in
## a league of its own

575+ Acres more per week With more capacity over competitive hydrostat spinners, spend less time
loading and more time covering acres.
$50,000+ annual revenue Continue generating revenue in the top-dress season when floaters are
parked.
30% less time between fields With the best transfer speed in the industry, spend less time on the
road and more time in the field.

## Generate revenue all season long

We aim to be your trusted source for application machinery. Our equipment doesn’t just work better
than the other industry standards, it works for you, generating higher revenue for your operation in
every season. Our applicators are engineered and built with the highest quality components to ensure
dependable, long-lasting results. That means you can run RBR machines longer and harder without
major uptime, giving you the quality and dependability you need for a successful season.

# Улучшим ваш бизнес

Повышение эффективности молочного животноводства

**«Умная ферма»** – инновационный проект ГК «ЭФКО», призванный повысить эффективность
сельскохозяйственного бизнеса за счет современных технологий и комплексного подхода в кормлении
животных. Проект объединяет несколько ключевых направлений: **Лабораторию эффективных кормов**,
**Аккредитованную лабораторию молочного животноводства**, **Дивизион эффективных кормов** и **два
специализированных завода по производству защищенных жиров и белков**. Все подразделения работают на
достижение общей цели – повышение стандартов эффективности в животноводстве.

# BUILT FOR COMMERCIAL

engineered for scale

Commercial biologics manufacturing demands infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational
precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed
for commercialization from day one. Our integrated drug substance operations in San Diego, CA and
Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

 **20,000L **U.S. single-use bioreactor capacity
 **3 **active commercial programs supplying **6 ** global markets
  **200+ **GMP batches executed
**100% ** first-pass PPQ success
**2 ** FDA-registered facilities specialized in late-stage production
**1 ** integrated early-stage development center of excellence

[ EXPLORE how we do it ][43]

# Advancing Biologics

one cell at a time

A technology-driven Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), Bora Biologics
specializes in mammalian and microbial development and manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate
access to cutting-edge technologies and comprehensive manufacturing capabilities that empower our
clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

[image description] [image description] [image description] [image description]

# End-to-End CDMO Solutions

tailored to you

We adapt seamlessly to your needs, ensuring efficiency and cost savings at every stage of
development and manufacturing. **Your success is our priority.**

## clinical to commercial scale

mammalian & microbial expertise

DEVELOPMENT PROCESSES
Process Development
[image description] [image description]

### process development

mammalian & microbial

Bora Biologics stands at the forefront of mammalian and microbial process development, excelling in
the design, optimization, and scale-up of biopharmaceutical production processes. With a
multidisciplinary approach and a focus on innovation, our team delivers customized solutions that
drive efficiency, quality, and accelerated time-to-market for biologics offerings.
* Cell line development
* High throughput media screening and optimization
* Mammalian cell culture development
* Microbial fermentation development
* High throughput resin screening and chromatography development
* Filtration process development (depth, sterile, viral, TFF)
* Inclusion body recovery and protein refold
* Conjugation and pegylation process optimization
* Technology transfer and scale up
* Viral clearance study design and support
* Process characterization

[ EXPLORE Our Systems ][44]
Analytical Development
[image description] [image description]

### Analytical Development

mammalian & microbial

At Bora Biologics, we empower your success in analytical development and product characterization
with tailored solutions and cutting-edge instrumentation, enabling seamless method development,
qualification, and validation for timely lot testing and release. Experience how we bring solutions
to market faster and more cost-effectively, so you can focus on what matters most: your success.
* Identity & Purity
* Structural Characterization
* Mechanism of Action
* Microbiology
* Analytical Validation

[ Explore Our Capabilities ][45]

TAIWAN
Hsinchu Biomedical Science Park, Zhubei City, Taiwan

single‑use platform technology, advancing programs from early development through clinical supply to
enable seamless transition to U.S. commercial manufacturing.EXPLORE

Zhubei City, Taiwan

On the forefront of the newest technologies, this facility features single-use technology for your
mammalian and microbial early-stage programs:

  and comparability.
* Global Tech Transfer Pathway: Designed to enable seamless progression to San Diego and Rockville
  facilities for late-stage and commercial supply.

  process development and clinical manufacturing.
* Process & Analytical Development (DS & DP): Integrated upstream, downstream, and formulation
  development to establish scalable, regulatory‑ready processes for drug substance and drug product.
* Analytical & Bioassay Development: Method development, qualification, and validation to support
  IND submissions, product characterization, and comparability assessments.
* QC Microbiology & Release Support: Dedicated microbiology and GMP testing teams ensuring compliant
  release and environmental monitoring for clinical supply.

East Coast Biotech Corridor, Rockville, MD, USA

Rockville, MD

technology and integrated quality systems, Rockville supports scalable commercial supply for global
markets.
* FDA registered GMP facility
* 11,000L installed commercial capacity
* 100% single-use drug substance manufacturing

Commercially scaled single‑use manufacturing infrastructure designed to ensure product segregation,

* Two 500L single‑use bioreactors
* Platform‑based upstream and downstream processes
* Closed processing architecture to minimize cross‑contamination risk
* Viral clearance and filtration capabilities
* Automated TFF systems

In‑house analytical infrastructure supporting release, stability, and comparability through

# Hi-tech Farming

Hi-tech farming, also known as precision agriculture or smart farming, refers to the use of advanced
technology and innovative methods to optimize crop yields, reduce waste, and promote sustainability
in agriculture.

1. Precision irrigation: Using sensors, drones, and satellite imaging to optimize water usage and
reduce waste.

2. Automated farming: Using autonomous tractors, drones, and robots to automate farming tasks, such
as planting, pruning, and harvesting.

3. Data analytics: Using advanced data analytics platforms to process vast amounts of data from
various sources, providing insights to inform decision-making.

4. Internet of Things (IoT): Connecting farms to the internet using IoT sensors and devices,
enabling real-time monitoring and control.

5. Artificial intelligence (AI): Using AI-powered systems to analyze data, predict weather patterns,
and provide personalized recommendations to farmers.

6. Vertical farming: Growing crops in vertically stacked layers, maximizing space and reducing land
use.

7. Drone technology: Using drones to monitor crop health, detect pests and diseases, and apply
targeted treatments.

8. Satellite imaging: Using satellite imaging to monitor crop growth, detect changes in soil
moisture, and predict weather patterns.

# Tunnel House Farming 

A Tunnel House is a structure that provides a controlled environment for plants. A plastic or
polythene sheet is used to cover the structure, filtering out sunlight and providing shade for
plants. This structure is suitable for growing plants in cold and snowy areas.

# Blueberry farming   

Blueberry is a fruit that is rich in nutrients and health benefits. It is high in antioxidants,
vitamin C, and fiber. Blueberry cultivation requires special care, such as growing in cold and
acidic soil. 

[READ MORE][73]

# Hydroponics, Aeroponics, Aquaponics

About Hydroponics, Aeroponics, Aquaponics,

Hydroponics is a technique of growing plants without soil. Plants are grown in a nutrient-rich
solution, rather than soil. This technique conserves water and land, compared to traditional
farming.

Aeroponics is a technique of growing plants in the air. Plants are grown in a nutrient-rich
solution, which is sprayed onto the roots. This technique conserves more water than hydroponics.

Aquaponics is a technique of growing plants and fish together in a single system. Plants are grown
in a nutrient-rich solution, while fish are raised in the same water. This technique conserves water
and land, compared to traditional farming.

agriculture information. They also provide agri consultancy services and collaborate with
agricultural management companies to enhance farming practices.

UNNATI 9 GROUP Best Agriculture Consultant in India, leading Agro based , Food & Agribusiness
Consulting Company dedicated to helping Farmers, Individuals, Entrepreneurs, Start-Ups, SMEs &
Corporate Organizations, strategically to transform (setup) their dream  Agri-Food Ventures in to

technology available, which will sustain and help them to establish, expand & revamp in this
changing & challenging business environment, and be a strategic consulting partner throughout the
business lifecycle, offering support at every stage to ensure the business remains compliant and
continuously growing. Our highly professional consulting team is young and dynamic having thrust to
serve you better and better always by providing technical and ethical practices during consulting
process. Our core competency in Agri-Food domain is resulting in technology transfer worldwide. We
are associated with good business houses and carry a strong base of loyal customers. We believe in
quality, not just with our product & services but also in business relationship. We are always open
to opportunities and networking as we value people who believe in fresh ideas.

# UNNATI 9 GROUP About the founder 

Dr. Sabha Bahadur Singh the founder of Unnati 9 Group, is a highly accomplished professional. Dr.
Singh is also working extensively on the Indian cow economy, focusing on promoting sustainable
practices related to Indian cows and their role in agriculture. Additionally, he serves as an
agricultural consultant in Europe and Africa, offering his expertise to help advance agricultural
practices across these regions. His contributions are aimed at fostering global agricultural
development, with a particular emphasis on sustainability and the economic value of agriculture.

[

Articles

][72]

# Hi-tech Farming

Hi-tech farming, also known as precision agriculture or smart farming, refers to the use of advanced
technology and innovative methods to optimize crop yields, reduce waste, and promote sustainability
in agriculture.

1. Precision irrigation: Using sensors, drones, and satellite imaging to optimize water usage and
reduce waste.

2. Automated farming: Using autonomous tractors, drones, and robots to automate farming tasks, such
as planting, pruning, and harvesting.

3. Data analytics: Using advanced data analytics platforms to process vast amounts of data from
various sources, providing insights to inform decision-making.

4. Internet of Things (IoT): Connecting farms to the internet using IoT sensors and devices,
enabling real-time monitoring and control.

5. Artificial intelligence (AI): Using AI-powered systems to analyze data, predict weather patterns,
and provide personalized recommendations to farmers.

6. Vertical farming: Growing crops in vertically stacked layers, maximizing space and reducing land
use.

7. Drone technology: Using drones to monitor crop health, detect pests and diseases, and apply
targeted treatments.

8. Satellite imaging: Using satellite imaging to monitor crop growth, detect changes in soil
moisture, and predict weather patterns.

# Tunnel House Farming 

A Tunnel House is a structure that provides a controlled environment for plants. A plastic or
polythene sheet is used to cover the structure, filtering out sunlight and providing shade for
plants. This structure is suitable for growing plants in cold and snowy areas.

# Blueberry farming   

Blueberry is a fruit that is rich in nutrients and health benefits. It is high in antioxidants,
vitamin C, and fiber. Blueberry cultivation requires special care, such as growing in cold and
acidic soil. 

[READ MORE][73]

# Hydroponics, Aeroponics, Aquaponics

About Hydroponics, Aeroponics, Aquaponics,

Hydroponics is a technique of growing plants without soil. Plants are grown in a nutrient-rich
solution, rather than soil. This technique conserves water and land, compared to traditional
farming.

Aeroponics is a technique of growing plants in the air. Plants are grown in a nutrient-rich
solution, which is sprayed onto the roots. This technique conserves more water than hydroponics.

Aquaponics is a technique of growing plants and fish together in a single system. Plants are grown
in a nutrient-rich solution, while fish are raised in the same water. This technique conserves water
and land, compared to traditional farming.

About Us

### About Vedanta Advance Farming

#### A Structured & Responsible Agricultural Enterprise

Vedanta Advanced Farming is a modern, structured, and responsible agricultural organization
dedicated to transforming Indian agriculture and animal husbandry into a long-term, sustainable, and
management-driven industrial ecosystem.

While agriculture and livestock farming in India hold immense potential, the absence of structured
planning, technology integration, professional management, and disciplined systems often prevents
stakeholders from realizing their full capabilities.

Vedanta Advanced Farming has been established to bridge this gap by creating a comprehensive
**Agri-Ecosystem** that addresses both operational and developmental challenges within the rural
agricultural landscape.

[Know More ][8]
[img]
Our Beneficiary Focus

##### We empower individuals and communities often excluded from mainstream development

## location_away **Corporate Cow Farming & Dairy Operations**

Corporate Cow Farming and Dairy Operations form the central and long-term focus of Vedanta Advanced
Farming.

**The key objectives of this division include:**
* Transforming traditional cow farming into a structured and regulated model
* Introducing technical discipline, consistency, and transparency in livestock management
* Creating responsible employment and sustainable business opportunities in rural areas

**Under this model:**
* The cow caretaker is responsible for daily rearing and maintenance
* The company provides veterinary, technical, and operational guidance
* Milk, livestock assets, and related processes are managed strictly as per company-defined policies
* The entire project operates under continuous company supervision and monitoring

**This division is particularly suitable for:**
* Rural youth and women interested in livestock farming
* Individuals seeking self-employment opportunities
* Groups aiming to work collaboratively under structured systems
* Those who wish to operate their own enterprise with organizational support

[Know More][9]

## school **Advanced Fruit Farming Division**

This division focuses on transforming fruit farming beyond seasonal limitations into a planned,
controlled, and market-oriented agricultural activity. Through modern irrigation systems, plantation
management, production planning, and monitoring mechanisms, the division aims to establish fruit
farming as a stable and sustainable agricultural practice.

[Know More][10]

## home_health **Advanced Agricultural Divisions**

Vedanta Advanced Farming also operates the following complementary agricultural divisions:
* **Advanced Fruit Farming**
  * Modern plantation techniques
  * Sustainable production management
  * Market-oriented cultivation planning
* **Advanced Polyhouse & Floriculture**
  * Controlled environment agriculture
  * Advanced greenhouse and Polyhouse concepts
  * Emphasis on quality-driven output

These divisions strengthen the core business and enhance the overall resilience of the integrated
agricultural model.

[Know More][11]

## Why Vedanta Advanced Farming
* Structured participation models
* Company-controlled operational processes
* Transparent governance
* Long-term strategic outlook
* Rural-centric development approach

Vedanta Advanced Farming has been established to bridge this gap by creating a comprehensive
**Agri-Ecosystem** that addresses both operational and developmental challenges within the rural
agricultural landscape.

[Know More ][8]
[img]
Our Beneficiary Focus

##### We empower individuals and communities often excluded from mainstream development

## location_away **Corporate Cow Farming & Dairy Operations**

Corporate Cow Farming and Dairy Operations form the central and long-term focus of Vedanta Advanced
Farming.

**The key objectives of this division include:**
* Transforming traditional cow farming into a structured and regulated model
* Introducing technical discipline, consistency, and transparency in livestock management
* Creating responsible employment and sustainable business opportunities in rural areas

**Under this model:**
* The cow caretaker is responsible for daily rearing and maintenance
* The company provides veterinary, technical, and operational guidance
* Milk, livestock assets, and related processes are managed strictly as per company-defined policies
* The entire project operates under continuous company supervision and monitoring

**This division is particularly suitable for:**
* Rural youth and women interested in livestock farming
* Individuals seeking self-employment opportunities
* Groups aiming to work collaboratively under structured systems
* Those who wish to operate their own enterprise with organizational support

[Know More][9]

## school **Advanced Fruit Farming Division**

This division focuses on transforming fruit farming beyond seasonal limitations into a planned,
controlled, and market-oriented agricultural activity. Through modern irrigation systems, plantation
management, production planning, and monitoring mechanisms, the division aims to establish fruit
farming as a stable and sustainable agricultural practice.

[Know More][10]

## home_health **Advanced Agricultural Divisions**

Vedanta Advanced Farming also operates the following complementary agricultural divisions:
* **Advanced Fruit Farming**
  * Modern plantation techniques
  * Sustainable production management
  * Market-oriented cultivation planning
* **Advanced Polyhouse & Floriculture**
  * Controlled environment agriculture
  * Advanced greenhouse and Polyhouse concepts
  * Emphasis on quality-driven output

These divisions strengthen the core business and enhance the overall resilience of the integrated
agricultural model.

[Know More][11]

## Why Vedanta Advanced Farming
* Structured participation models
* Company-controlled operational processes
* Transparent governance
* Long-term strategic outlook
* Rural-centric development approach

# Yamaha
# Agriculture

Built to perform. Automation that pulls its weight.

We build smart products that stand up to the land, lighten the load, and help you get the best out
of every plant, every season. Designed to tackle your toughest challenges – through precision tools
that are built to perform.

[ View crop types ][25]
[ Our products ][26]

## Trusted by growers. Built for the future.
* OUR MISSION

Yamaha Agriculture is built to serve the way you work in the rows, blocks, and orchards you manage
every day. As Yamaha Motor’s agriculture company, our mission is to make specialty crop growers more
sustainable, profitable and resilient in the face of labor shortages, climate volatility and
tightening margins by building precision tools that combine automation, AI-powered insights and
decades of engineering heritage.

[ Read more about us ][27]

Speciality crop focused

Every product and decision we make is shaped by the realities of specialty crop growing – the value,
the volatility, the precision required, the seasonality.

Integrated by design

Most solutions focus on either equipment or data. We combine both into one connected system so
everything works together, seamlessly.

Partners for the long haul

Specialty crop growing is a long-term investment. We show up the same way - reliable, committed and
accountable, season after season.

## Better outcomes, season after season
* KEY BENEFITS

In partnership with growers, we are building a seamlessly connected future where sensing, autonomy,
and intelligence work together – helping you to plan, act, and adapt with confidence. 

### Work smarter with less labor

Automation reduces manual spraying and repetitive tasks, helping crews cover more ground during peak
seasonal pressure

### Consistent coverage, block after block

Precise, repeatable application delivers even spray coverage across vines and trees for healthier
crops and more uniform results

### Lower cost per acre

## Better outcomes, season after season

### Work smarter with less labor

Automation reduces manual spraying and repetitive tasks, helping crews cover more ground during peak

### Consistent coverage, block after block

Precise, repeatable application delivers even spray coverage across vines and trees for healthier
crops and more uniform results

### Lower cost per acre

Fewer passes and optimized input use reduces fuel, chemical, and labor costs without sacrificing
performance

### Faster decisions, backed by data

Operational data and sensing provides clear visibility across blocks, supporting quicker decisions
and more confident planning

### Built for speciality crops

Designed to perform in dust, heat, slopes, tight rows, and long days - keeping operations moving
when timing is critical

### The right technology, working together

One interoperable ecosystem, bringing together the technologies you need to perform and scale

## Trusted by growers. Built for the future.
* OUR MISSION

Yamaha Agriculture is built to serve the way you work in the rows, blocks, and orchards you manage
every day. As Yamaha Motor’s agriculture company, our mission is to make specialty crop growers more
sustainable, profitable and resilient in the face of labor shortages, climate volatility and
tightening margins by building precision tools that combine automation, AI-powered insights and
decades of engineering heritage.

[ Read more about us ][27]

Speciality crop focused

Every product and decision we make is shaped by the realities of specialty crop growing – the value,
the volatility, the precision required, the seasonality.

Integrated by design

Most solutions focus on either equipment or data. We combine both into one connected system so
everything works together, seamlessly.

Partners for the long haul

Specialty crop growing is a long-term investment. We show up the same way - reliable, committed and
accountable, season after season.

## Better outcomes, season after season
* KEY BENEFITS

In partnership with growers, we are building a seamlessly connected future where sensing, autonomy,
and intelligence work together – helping you to plan, act, and adapt with confidence. 

### Work smarter with less labor

Automation reduces manual spraying and repetitive tasks, helping crews cover more ground during peak
seasonal pressure

### Consistent coverage, block after block

Precise, repeatable application delivers even spray coverage across vines and trees for healthier
crops and more uniform results

### Lower cost per acre

Fewer passes and optimized input use reduces fuel, chemical, and labor costs without sacrificing
performance

### Faster decisions, backed by data

Operational data and sensing provides clear visibility across blocks, supporting quicker decisions
and more confident planning

### Built for speciality crops

Designed to perform in dust, heat, slopes, tight rows, and long days - keeping operations moving
when timing is critical

### The right technology, working together

One interoperable ecosystem, bringing together the technologies you need to perform and scale
